name: DataHub
summary: Send OpenLineage run events with Ogun facets to the OpenLineage endpoint of a DataHub metadata service (GMS), authenticated with a personal access token.

fields.name: access_token
fields.label: Personal access token
fields.help: Created in DataHub; sent as a bearer token. Store it with ogun secrets set.

settings.name: url
settings.label: GMS URL
settings.help: Base URL of the DataHub metadata service (GMS).

settings.name: path
settings.label: OpenLineage path
settings.help: Check the DataHub documentation for the OpenLineage path of your version.

settings.name: namespace
settings.label: Namespace
settings.help: OpenLineage namespace for Ogun jobs and datasets.

egress.note: The host of the url setting, on the port in the url.

notes: Ogun sends OpenLineage run events with Ogun facets for artifacts and windows, through an outbox (ADR 0012). The path has no default: check the vendor documentation for your DataHub version. This build reaches http:// endpoints only; an https GMS needs a local TLS forwarder.
